Staging (test builds): vault release log

Staging release 9 (test build)

Release 9 fixes a problem where your vault could lock itself again right after an update, and prepares it for push notifications through Google and Apple.

Status

Status
Active
Published
2026-10-11
End date
Not set

The current release. New vaults are enrolled into it, and the app offers it to everyone on an older release.

Changes

  • Fixed: after updating, the vault could lock again within a minute and ask you to unlock once more. Unlocking a vault that is already open now keeps it open.
  • New: your vault can register this phone for push notifications, so that in a later app update notifications can arrive without the app's on-phone service.
  • The push carries no content: Google or Apple only learn that VettID woke your phone, never what for. Nothing changes until you choose Google push in the app.
  • Your vault's network access gains one address: VettID's push service for this channel (push.staging.vettid.org). Nothing else is added.

Security

No security fix
